notes.title: Alpha Demo & Hello from PAX East 2017!
notes.content:
We packed our bags in San Francisco, took yet another long flight across USA, and unpacked our bags again in chilly Boston for PAX East. It was actually snowing this morning and it's probably fair to say that this tropical team is underdressed. However, while we are frozen cold, we are having a good time showcasing Legrand Legacy in PAX East and we also have a very important update to share with you -  Legrand Legacy’s Alpha demo!

[h1]Updates on Alpha Demo[/h1]  

Kickstarter backers who have pledged in the [b]Adventurer tier (£50)[/b]and above will be receiving Legrand Legacy’s Alpha demo on [b]March 31st[/b] The feedback we received was overwhelmingly in favor of version B’s battle system, so that’s what we will be using going forward. 

The Alpha demo will contain the first TWO chapters of Legrand Legacy so you will get a first look at how Finn and Aria’s adventures will unfold and an exclusive sneak peek to a whole new region to explore in Legrand, as well as updated visual effects and battle UI/UX, among others.  

If you have backed at a lower tier but now want a copy of our Alpha, please consider upgrading your pledge via [url=https://paypal.legrandlegacy.com/projects/legrand-legacy-tale-of-the-fatebounds/]Legrand Legacy’s PayPal[/url], where you can also check the current status of our project’s crowdfunding and how far we are from the next stretch goal (£47,000 with a new Mini Boss and its own unique bonus loot). If you are interested in upgrading your pledge, please email us at [h1]slackerbacker@semisoft.co[/h1].   

[h1]PAX East 2017[/h1]  

Today marks the first day of PAX East in Boston and it has been fun, busy, and crowded at the same time. The highlight of the day was meeting some of our Kickstarter backers and getting the chance to chat with them about how to improve several aspects of the mini games and tactical war. Here are some pictures from our booth in PAX East:  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/819/010/e1fb85800d5ea4d0577554bb9f2e3a47_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1489179442&auto=format&q=92&s=52a034b8f40fd1f389f269fda3d8b38c[/img]

If you are attending PAX East in Boston, please come say hi to the team at booth 23120 from March 10-12. Just tell us you’re one of our Kickstarter backers and we have a special surprise for you!  

[h1]Post GDC Rants & Afterthoughts[/h1]  

In short, GDC was insanely hectic and memorable. We gathered even more feedback on how to improve players’ experience overall and also met a torrent of talented individuals from all aspects of the gaming industry, including publishers, musicians, artists, and of course, fellow game devs.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/813/740/bc80d436e06cf341ba48e98e894d17dc_original.JPG?w=639&fit=max&v=1489148037&auto=format&q=92&s=2b88c4ec07ecee0a36d8afc271133209[/img]

The highlight of our entire San Francisco trip was showcasing Legrand Legacy in the Game Jolt x Kickstarter party! It was such an honor to be showing alongside other awesome games like Moonlighter, The Adventure Pals, and Space Jammers. We also had a lot of fun playing these games and meeting Anya and Luke from Kickstarter Games!  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/813/650/1a8f34fef939de2aa0df900ffd90c662_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1489147197&auto=format&q=92&s=fc9aafd298deb88c8a51bd0ffe2ceef3[/img]

Photos above courtesy of @AJ_theReal, @chibichibieris, @MassiveMonsters, and @_adaptiveplay.

Uwil and AJ's personal highlight, however, was meeting their idol, Daniel Floyd from Extra Credits.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/813/652/d74f201dd88b93e07ebdfe45ec1185e5_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1489147209&auto=format&q=92&s=eb155a76a5ee938032d63627cb0c7fce[/img]

In the following video, Uwil shares his thoughts on the aftermath of GDC 2017 - what we should've done better, what's up with Legrand Legacy's mini games, and why popcorn is your best friend!  

https://youtu.be/kPIQNA2b-P8

We also did a live interview with Beau Gaming who was kind enough to stop by our booth and has a bunch of cool videos from GDC 2017.  

[h1]2016 Giveaway Update[/h1] 

Towards the end of our first Kickstarter campaign in December 2016, we ran a few giveaways via Twitter and Facebook. Now that we are funded, we are able to continue with the development of Legrand Legacy and thus, honor the winners of these giveaways. If you have won, we will be contacting you soon with more information. 

That’s it for this week’s update! We hope that you have enjoyed the videos and pictures included here. We will be back next week with more live updates from SXSW Gaming Expo in Austin. If you want to follow the team's journey, you can follow our personal Twitter (@uwilwinata, @aj_thereal, @chibichibieris). 

See you next week!

notes.title: Hello from GDC Play 2017!
notes.content:
Hi! After two VERY long flights totaling almost 20 hours, we arrived in San Francisco for GDC Play 2017! San Francisco is such a beautiful, laid back city, and we are so in love with the cool weather – it’s certainly a nice change from the usually hot and humid Jakarta. BUT we don't have much time to play, so let's dive straight into our live report from Semisoft Studio's first day in GDC Play 2017.

[b]What's GDC Play?[/b]

GDC Play features emerging game studios from all corners of the world. The level of indie creativity in this building is just impossibly high! If you're coming to GDC, please don't forget to say hi to Uwil (@uwilwinata) and AJ (@aj.thereal) at GDC Play 2017 (North Hall), booth PL4030 from March 1-3. We'd love to meet and chat with our Kickstarter backers!

https://youtu.be/r_ru7PbihQE

Since our Kickstarter ended, we have been busy with development work as we prepared for our trip to the US. It's the first time we're showcasing Legrand Legacy in North America and we're so far away from home that we have to admit… we were very nervous! However, our worries were immediately dispelled as our booth was constantly packed with curious passers-by and RPG-fans alike, who were immediately taken by Legrand Legacy’s art style.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/717/353/f033adec45765336cb948906015ce4ea_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1488487184&auto=format&lossless=true&s=eb8bb36145093dcdafa2118b22ec1a40[/img]

[b]So Much Swag[/b]

Our suitcases were packed with a ton of swag - including t-shirts, fancy mints, and other cool stuff. Please come by our booth, beat our challenge, and win this limited edition t-shirt featuring some awesome new Legrand Legacy artwork!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/717/365/32464434bcb6624bb9d4812e03bedb3b_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1488487234&auto=format&q=92&s=1db2b61cd5652c9d7cd3de66ca91eb84[/img]

[b]What's New with Legrand Legacy?[/b]

As far as development is concerned, we have made significant progress in several aspects of the game, especially on tactical war and the mini games, both of which are featured in the special build we brought with us to GDC.

You might remember the earlier tactical war screenshots from Legrand Legacy's first Kickstarter at the end of 2016. So much has changed since then and this is how tactical war currently looks:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/717/390/33715c0c752d7eea8eaab0a8195b4bd9_original.PNG?w=639&fit=max&v=1488487348&auto=format&lossless=true&s=4786bc78511b6d7b90f54020e848e096[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/717/399/c99e45c06598a642f0e43995808b82f5_original.PNG?w=639&fit=max&v=1488487393&auto=format&lossless=true&s=4a41496141e8111fa62e6bf2e1513cf1[/img]

What do you think? Do you like the current look for tactical war ? This is not even its final form yet as we're still polishing and perfecting it so we can include it in an updated build.

[b]More Good News![/b]

We are proud to announce that Legrand Legacy has been selected as a contestant in the [url=https://gaming.sxsw.com/program/pitch-competition/]SXSW Gaming Pitch Competition[/url]. Uwil and AJ will be presenting to a group of gaming industry veterans, which will hopefully help to bring Legrand Legacy to the next level and beyond!

This also means Semisoft Studio will be attending SXSW Gaming Expo in Austin from Mar 16-18! Where are our Texan backers? Please come by our booth to collect your Legrand Legacy swag.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/717/442/358a0921f89fab01b8927e8765d9552f_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1488487557&auto=format&q=92&s=0354f27bac58a477774ef07f694d861d[/img]

That was a long update! We hope you enjoyed the many pictures included here. We will also be going live from all three events on Twitter and Facebook so don't forget to [url=https://twitter.com/LegrandLegacy]follow us[/url] and like our [url=https://www.facebook.com/legrandlegacy/]page![/url] We will also have an update about Legrand Legacy’s Alpha build very soon.

And now, before we go we wanted to talk about a project we're currently backing. [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/agatestudio/valthirian-arc-red-covenant-academy-for-heroes]Valthirian Arc: Red Covenant - Academy for Heroes[/url] from Agate Studio, as its name suggests, is a game where you are put in charge of managing your very own Academy of Heroes! You can try a demo for the game at their Kickstarter page, so be sure to check that out and support their cause!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/702/696/5575c44ab57728675e9888c91e3832f1_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1488398870&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=36b39776127fc0f43705500036fa334f[/img]

GDC Play features emerging game studios from all corners of the world. The level of indie creativity in this building is just impossibly high! If you're coming to GDC, please don't forget to say hi to Uwil (@uwilwinata) and AJ (@aj.thereal) at GDC Play 2017 (North Hall), booth PL4030 from March 1-3. We'd love to meet and chat with our Kickstarter backers!

https://youtu.be/r_ru7PbihQE

Since our Kickstarter ended, we have been busy with development work as we prepared for our trip to the US. It's the first time we're showcasing Legrand Legacy in North America and we're so far away from home that we have to admit… we were very nervous! However, our worries were immediately dispelled as our booth was constantly packed with curious passers-by and RPG-fans alike, who were immediately taken by Legrand Legacy’s art style.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/717/353/f033adec45765336cb948906015ce4ea_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1488487184&auto=format&lossless=true&s=eb8bb36145093dcdafa2118b22ec1a40[/img]

[b]So Much Swag[/b]

Our suitcases were packed with a ton of swag - including t-shirts, fancy mints, and other cool stuff. Please come by our booth, beat our challenge, and win this limited edition t-shirt featuring some awesome new Legrand Legacy artwork!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/717/365/32464434bcb6624bb9d4812e03bedb3b_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1488487234&auto=format&q=92&s=1db2b61cd5652c9d7cd3de66ca91eb84[/img]

[b]What's New with Legrand Legacy?[/b]

As far as development is concerned, we have made significant progress in several aspects of the game, especially on tactical war and the mini games, both of which are featured in the special build we brought with us to GDC.

You might remember the earlier tactical war screenshots from Legrand Legacy's first Kickstarter at the end of 2016. So much has changed since then and this is how tactical war currently looks:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/717/390/33715c0c752d7eea8eaab0a8195b4bd9_original.PNG?w=639&fit=max&v=1488487348&auto=format&lossless=true&s=4786bc78511b6d7b90f54020e848e096[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/717/399/c99e45c06598a642f0e43995808b82f5_original.PNG?w=639&fit=max&v=1488487393&auto=format&lossless=true&s=4a41496141e8111fa62e6bf2e1513cf1[/img]

What do you think? Do you like the current look for tactical war ? This is not even its final form yet as we're still polishing and perfecting it so we can include it in an updated build.

[b]More Good News![/b]

We are proud to announce that Legrand Legacy has been selected as a contestant in the [url=https://gaming.sxsw.com/program/pitch-competition/]SXSW Gaming Pitch Competition[/url]. Uwil and AJ will be presenting to a group of gaming industry veterans, which will hopefully help to bring Legrand Legacy to the next level and beyond!

This also means Semisoft Studio will be attending SXSW Gaming Expo in Austin from Mar 16-18! Where are our Texan backers? Please come by our booth to collect your Legrand Legacy swag.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/717/442/358a0921f89fab01b8927e8765d9552f_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1488487557&auto=format&q=92&s=0354f27bac58a477774ef07f694d861d[/img]

That was a long update! We hope you enjoyed the many pictures included here. We will also be going live from all three events on Twitter and Facebook so don't forget to [url=https://twitter.com/LegrandLegacy]follow us[/url] and like our [url=https://www.facebook.com/legrandlegacy/]page![/url] We will also have an update about Legrand Legacy’s Alpha build very soon.

And now, before we go we wanted to talk about a project we're currently backing. [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/agatestudio/valthirian-arc-red-covenant-academy-for-heroes]Valthirian Arc: Red Covenant - Academy for Heroes[/url] from Agate Studio, as its name suggests, is a game where you are put in charge of managing your very own Academy of Heroes! You can try a demo for the game at their Kickstarter page, so be sure to check that out and support their cause!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/702/696/5575c44ab57728675e9888c91e3832f1_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1488398870&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=36b39776127fc0f43705500036fa334f[/img]

notes.title: Check Your Pledge!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! After hibernating for a bit in order to recover from our Kickstarter campaign, we're back and working hard on Legrand Legacy! We'll have an update for you next week to talk about the game, as right now we're focusing on the development side of things so that we can be ready for our trip to GDC next week!

We do want to quickly talk about an issue with the pledges of some backers since Kickstarter has not been able to collect them. This usually happens because Kickstarter tries to charge the card attached to your Kickstarter account but your bank puts a block on the transaction. Other times your card might have expired. 

You should have gotten an email from Kickstarter for Legrand Legacy telling you either that your pledge has been collected or that there's a problem with your pledge. If you got the second type of email, you need to call your bank to lift the block on the transaction, or else your pledge will not be collected and you won't be able to receive your rewards. You have until Friday morning to call your bank!

We also wanted to talk today about a couple of indie projects we're supporting and which we hope you can support as well! Kickstarter is a community, and us indies have to help each other.

https://youtu.be/kQejZmOlIDI

A friend of Semisoft has launched their Greenlight campaign for a beautiful pixel Ghost N Goblins inspired title called [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=863585217]Battle Princess Madelyn[/url] . It also draws some inspiration from Wonder Boy 3: The Dragon's Trap, as you can see from the game's trailer below! [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=863585217]Click right here[/url] to vote for it to be approved for a Steam release!

notes.title: The Final Journey Begins
notes.content:
Friends of Legrand Legacy.

Together we have crossed the finish line in the most spectacular fashion! The final 48 hours were so intense and exhilarating – you raised your pledges, retweeted like there was no tomorrow, and an incredible surge of new backers joined us in the last few hours. And it’s because of all of your relentless support, we managed to reach over 110% funded and achieved two stretch goals along the way!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/545/905/d2c8b2eed3163f1542451a03aad72d84_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1487359602&auto=format&lossless=true&s=db864f0c193fbfdaeeb915cdc679a780[/img]

So… what’s next?

We have been contacted by many people who don’t have a credit card and couldn’t pledge to our Kickstarter. As such, we have worked on a [url=https://paypal.legrandlegacy.com/projects/legrand-legacy-tale-of-the-fatebounds/]PayPal[/url] option so that anyone who missed our Kickstarter campaign can also pledge and help us reach additional stretch goals. This will be an extension of the Kickstarter crowdfunding run and will only be available for a limited time.

[url=https://paypal.legrandlegacy.com/projects/legrand-legacy-tale-of-the-fatebounds/][img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/546/857/73fdb0f180d44c9f35dedf49adca0e13_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1487364411&auto=format&q=92&s=aaea6e8d470deb2d75f8228a7a079f97[/img][/url]

Those of you who have already pledged to Legrand Legacy can also use PayPal to increase your pledge to a higher reward tier to get more rewards while also helping us to reach our pending stretch goals! If you'd like to do this, please contact us by clicking in our profile in the upper left corner and using the "Contact Me" button. That way we'll be able to work with you on upgrading your pledge tier!

[b]But that’s not all![/b]

Thanks to YOU making this Kickstarter campaign a success, our generous benefactors have agreed to sponsor Legrand Legacy to attend [url=http://www.gdconf.com/events/gdcplay.html]GDC Play[/url] (San Francisco, Mar 1-3) and [url=http://east.paxsite.com/]PAX East[/url] (Boston, Mar 10-12). If you happen to be around the area, please come by our humble little booth and say hi! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/546/874/a6981ac06c88b26dfa069be7487ca6b0_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1487364477&auto=format&q=92&s=9ffbe6c440d8a5df31b695cebc4d16bc[/img]

We would love to meet and chat with our Kickstarter backers. PLUS, we’ll have Legrand Legacy goodies and fun giveaways for players who manage to beat Klahmaran, right there and then. We know all of our backers have had a good trial run and will have no problem beating this epic boss!

Uwil and AJ will be manning the booth in both GDC and Pax East, so please keep an eye out for these guys. 

You can also follow them on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/uwilwinata]@uwilwinata[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/AJ_theReal]@AJ_theReal.[/url]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/545/837/43a3ce4a09bc2c718a63e710500f965d_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1487359249&auto=format&lossless=true&s=fb5b0eff3918e029454cc1ac4cb83403[/img]

Once again, thank you… thank you… thank you! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/546/889/c73ba669322fd96d98bde45992b59131_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1487364543&auto=format&q=92&s=f0adcfe1fb82c0f23f6ba5c6833d67a1[/img]

Now that Legrand Legacy is fully funded, we will continue working on the development of the game. We will take a few days to rest and get some sleep, and will be back on Kickstarter to keep all our backers informed on the current status of Legrand Legacy, as we share new info on how the final version of the game is shaping up! We also hope that you will stay in touch! Please sign up for our [url=http://legrandlegacy.com/]newsletter[/url], follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/LegrandLegacy]Twitter[/url], and do like our [url=https://www.facebook.com/legrandlegacy/]Facebook[/url] page. 

We also have to thank the fine folk at [url=http://www.prhound.co.uk/]PR Hound![/url] They have worked with many Kickstarter campaigns you've probably seen such as Wolcen: Lords of Mayhem, Woven, Buck, InSomnia, War of Rights, and plenty more! If you're thinking about taking a project to Kickstarter, we highly recommend their services!

notes.title: Rungdahl – The Troubled One
notes.content:
As part of our Kickstarter Social Media Bonus Goals, we promised to include a new recruitable NPC to help you rebuild Dumville Castle. Today, we thought we'd let you have a sneak peek at Rungdahl!

Originally a  priestess from the Maeshapolis Monastery, Rungdahl has an uncanny ability to discover many valuable things. From precious rare gems to powerful potions and exotic spices from faraway land, she always seems to know exactly what everyone needs and precisely where to find them. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/520/285/e8aa6fc229c1d38d4ea5f35399a9f4e5_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1487189331&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=f8facad6dc4f45a8d2fe20e2b4f4b19d[/img]

Some say she is blessed with the "gift of sight" enabling her to track down any uncommon items in Legrand. Some some chalk it up to her tenacious attitude and charming ability to extract the necessary information out of practically anyone.

However, Rungdahl has broken a sacred law by having an intimate relationship which is strictly forbidden and resulted in her banishment from the Monastery. With nothing else to fall back on, she travels to Dunabad with her lover to start a new life together. Since then, she has felt a deep sense of dissatisfaction and unhappiness as her lover's true malicious intents finally come to the surface. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/520/899/5577bdd0a4a27886f7951cf686f886db_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1487192188&auto=format&lossless=true&s=b1fc1bd65c2fd1de407af32c3d5cac8c[/img]

[url=https://skfb.ly/ZRXn]Here's the 3D model for Rungdahl[/url]

What do you think about Rungdahl? Are you looking forward to rebuilding Dumville Castle with her? Please don't forget to like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/legrandlegacy/]Facebook[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/LegrandLegacy]Twitter[/url] as we still have more Social Media Bonus Goals to reach!

notes.title: Stuff Of Nightmares
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's time for a new Kickstarter update. Before we get right to it, we wanted to mention that thanks to your support and all the Facebook likes you've given us and by following us on Twitter, you've managed to reach two new Social Media Bonus Goals!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/508/067/260a27dcad561932bce5dd74d149aedd_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1487105784&auto=format&lossless=true&s=263ea9c668a7003d038d284829cef6f6[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/508/076/b574268ae09fc4a8ecffab53edcf9448_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1487105814&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a6d2d4e49132d5050187ac05573e2cc9[/img]

Monsters, lovely and dangerous monsters. There’s plenty of them in Legrand Legacy, and the team has been busy working on the design, look and lore for each one of them. Today we want to give you a glimpse of what makes two monsters in particular tick. As you’re about to see, some monsters have a truly gruesome and disturbing history – the kind of stuff that nightmares are made of.

[b]Matakar - Incarnation of Begrudged Souls[/b]

Back in the old days, there lived a tribe that performed baby burying ritual as a sacrificial token to bring rain and prosperity. They used to bury young babies inside a cluster of sacred trees, thus trapping their innocent souls inside.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/500/777/9889b957a6f1961d5ccfbfa0dc1d98f8_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1487055548&auto=format&lossless=true&s=3ef15e6865e8698012c705fb64d998d5[/img]

Centuries later, the tribe had gone and people forgot about their forsaken burial site. However, these trapped begrudged souls, who never got to taste life, evolved into sentient trees with multiple eyes and a thorny arm… and they seek to kill all adults, and eat human babies to keep themselves alive.

[url=https://skfb.ly/YqWz]Here’s the 3D model for Matakar[/url]

[b]Ablumors – Not Part of This World Or The Afterlife[/b] 

Legend has it that spirits of the dead and tortured Norns never quite left their homeland of Finias. Instead, black magic and ancient rituals have trapped these poor souls in the body of blood-thirsty beasts that are not part of this world or of the afterlife. When you think about it, if you end up killing them you are actually doing them a favor.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/500/780/24153c8454fb71529cf0beb916994f05_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1487055599&auto=format&lossless=true&s=89e7f5cffe7b9fb11490872e5f30f7a1[/img]

[url=https://skfb.ly/WnJv]Here’s the 3D model for Ablumors[/url]

What do you think of today’s pair of monsters? Let us know in the comments below!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/500/777/9889b957a6f1961d5ccfbfa0dc1d98f8_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1487055548&auto=format&lossless=true&s=3ef15e6865e8698012c705fb64d998d5[/img]

Centuries later, the tribe had gone and people forgot about their forsaken burial site. However, these trapped begrudged souls, who never got to taste life, evolved into sentient trees with multiple eyes and a thorny arm… and they seek to kill all adults, and eat human babies to keep themselves alive.

[url=https://skfb.ly/YqWz]Here’s the 3D model for Matakar[/url]

[b]Ablumors – Not Part of This World Or The Afterlife[/b] 

Legend has it that spirits of the dead and tortured Norns never quite left their homeland of Finias. Instead, black magic and ancient rituals have trapped these poor souls in the body of blood-thirsty beasts that are not part of this world or of the afterlife. When you think about it, if you end up killing them you are actually doing them a favor.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/500/780/24153c8454fb71529cf0beb916994f05_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1487055599&auto=format&lossless=true&s=89e7f5cffe7b9fb11490872e5f30f7a1[/img]

[url=https://skfb.ly/WnJv]Here’s the 3D model for Ablumors[/url]

What do you think of today’s pair of monsters? Let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Gwenelle Forest – Lush, Beautiful... Yet Forbidden
notes.content:
Welcome to a new Kickstarter update! There is now less than £3,000 to fund with a week left for Legrand Legacy! We are thrilled about all the support you've shown us. Now we're in the final run towards the goal! If all current backers raised their pledge to become part of [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/984434986/legrand-legacy-tale-of-the-fatebounds/posts/1797673]The Fallen Gladiators of Legrand[/url], we'd make it to the goal and then some! If you're considering increasing your to a higher reward tier, or if you've been considering getting some of the limited edition physical rewards we offer exclusively for the crowdfunding campaign for Legrand Legacy, now is the time to do so!

The lush and beautiful Gwenelle Forest is home to the reclusive Aos Si, and the last remaining green area in all of Legrand. It has an enchanted yet forbidden aura about it, and rightfully so. Gwenelle Forest is relentlessly shielded by the powerful magic of the Aos Si, who refuse to let the effects of the Mugna Feud reach their sacred home. This is also probably why few people are aware of the exact location of the Aos Si’s township. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/454/263/c8e0da722ef8e8c953905089e187abff_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1486677698&auto=format&lossless=true&s=667c0b0d950361f9c6256f30438ce032[/img]

Gwenelle Forest is home to plenty of fascinating flora and fauna specimen. You can rest assured that Finn and friends will have a lot of exciting things to look out for in this mesmerizing forest!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/454/346/c433689112fec8439ae9b380f112fb8f_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1486678243&auto=format&q=92&s=891d09c73fdc2f773a5e9f93b0655f21[/img]

The Great War hundreds of years ago left its mark in Gwenelle in the form of ruined temples, destroyed buildings, as well as the remains of an ancient dragon.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/454/357/59ef6fe1e5a0533cdf13d742d653597f_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1486678275&auto=format&q=92&s=8057e7c999ba6aa4f70ecc91f75e22fb[/img]

[b]The Aos Si[/b]

The Aos Si is a race of celestial elf-like creatures who used to live in peace all over Gwenelle. However, since the Great War has devastated most of their homes, they decided to travel to a deeper part of the forest and that’s where they have resided ever since - hidden and far away from the rest of the world.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/454/387/ab9a681039e3f354cbb4b93fc8f8645f_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1486678479&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5e78cebf93c7a806cfdac850bf5c3091[/img]

This has been one of our most favorite areas to design, and we hope you like it too!

notes.title: The Quirky and Unexplainable
notes.content:
As we have said before, one of the most creatively liberating things to design in Legrand Legacy is the monsters since they leave a lot of room for our imaginations to run wild and go a bit into crazy territory.

Sometimes we take inspirations from mythical beasts or animals in the wild. And sometimes… sometimes we don’t really have a good explanation for some of the quirkier monsters. Take the Akodki and Cullemerk. They just sort of… appeared out of nowhere!

[b]Akodki - The Trap of Hyper Reality[/b]

Don’t be fooled by their cutesy and colorful appearance, what with the cute flower crown and pink mushroom umbrella. Once they put on all of their accessories, you will be trapped in the hyper reality realm of their psychedelic imagination!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/430/593/fcbcc112f82199d2d8ca4879364bfc1c_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1486510590&auto=format&lossless=true&s=f7b5efd46ef436a3b34cc96a1fac705d[/img]

Akodkis use their signature “potion of love” - an intoxicating scent that makes you fall in love with them - to attack their enemies. Love hurts, doesn’t it?

[url=https://skfb.ly/XvrE]Here’s the 3D model for Akodki[/url]

[b]Cullemerk - The Quiet One[/b]

Cullemerks are giant polar monsters who are always misunderstood simply because of their giant stature and creepy smiley face. No other creature dares to talk to them, making them mostly lonely. They are also very individualistic and rarely socialize among themselves! Instead, they can often be found holed up in their own caves or strolling alone in the middle of the night as they try to find new painful ways to kill their enemies.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/430/736/6620ee905ba5382939e6f480b6a08da8_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1486511418&auto=format&lossless=true&s=6a4b27b66c3bf79d186173b20f17ec4c[/img]

We heard through the grapevine that Cullemerk’s design was largely inspired by a drawing created by one of our designers based on a creature he (thought) saw in his own bedroom. So… yeah. Cullemerk is a weird one, huh?

[url=https://skfb.ly/WnJr]Here’s the 3D model for Cullemerk[/url]

What do you think about these quirky monsters? Do you want more monsters such as these in the game? Let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Finnias – Home of the Undead
notes.content:
Finnias is a desolate swampland that used to be the thriving and prosperous hometown of the Norns. The Great War turned Finnias into a city of, ruins riddled with the wandering and vengeful spirits of the undead.

Few dare to visit Finnias as it is now… nothing but a mere pile of debris left in the middle of this dark and dangerous jungle - a sad remembrance of what was once the most advanced civilization in all of Legrand.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/419/593/87417ba18c330ce93ff7c2d770327377_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1486441581&auto=format&lossless=true&s=ae7982922aeb7be50c4f4e2bda3c3b0d[/img]

[b]The Norns[/b]

If you have played the Legrand Legacy Pre-Alpha, then you probably remember that Geddo is a Norn who communicates via telepathy. In fact, all Norns are voiceless and can only communicate telepathically. 

Because of this, they memorized every event through images or ancient runes, which can be seen from the relics left behind amidst the ruins of this once flourishing settlement. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/419/601/2548720b25fd4afb5c1be064dc4bb7e0_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1486441656&auto=format&q=92&s=98efaed57406a38752fb8e0b8a00d4f8[/img]

[b]The Dathi Tree[/b]

The Dathi tree is a massive ancient tree that is one of the balancing pillars of the Legrand world. Needless to say, the tree is heavily protected by powerful magic as it is constantly under attack by mysterious dark forces who aspire to conquer Legrand… no matter the cost.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/419/728/3c1b46654d8df73979cc1a21bc0f1c10_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1486442549&auto=format&q=92&s=e207991366e4e9f59c044b374549d581[/img]

Don’t you think there’s something oddly beautiful about this dark, gloomy place?

notes.title: Inspired by the Wild
notes.content:
Legrand is chockfull of malicious monsters, gruesome beasts, and a dash of the familiar. The inspirations behind the following monsters are easily recognizable while still having the Legrand Legacy twist applied to them.

For today’s update, we wanted to talk about a couple of monsters that are inspired by the wild: Smutar and Mbedug! 

[h1]Smutar, the Paralyzing Ant[/h1]

Smutars are family creatures that live in big colonies with thousands of other members of its species. They are hard workers who burrow deep underground to establish their nest, but they migrate frequently according to the season. 

The glowing red sphere at their back acts as a lure that attracts smaller species which are paralyzed upon contact. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/408/205/ac47c9e1774d0c74aa0298211e85cca1_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1486361965&auto=format&lossless=true&s=406e9d3170d5d6f300e9cd3c5afaf69a[/img]

[url=https://sketchfab.com/models/c03db799f2a24abd9b7b82f7924a0e77]Here’s the 3D model for Smutar[/url]

[h1]Mbedug, the Witches’ Favorite[/h1]

Mbedugs are solitary mammals that can be easily recognized by their stout long horn and fluffy ears. Their horns are a precious and sought-after commodity as local witches often use them in their mysteriously vile brews. 

While Mbedugs do spend most of their time sleeping and eating, be careful if you happen to meet one in the wild - they can suddenly charge and attack without warning! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/408/209/36c2217c34050eeabc4287da71668698_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1486362083&auto=format&lossless=true&s=f0d9659627f99f9afd258004bd2b4bae[/img]

[url=https://sketchfab.com/models/a8ec1c9ab1ca4f8faee096c1bcb60bc8]Here’s the 3D model for Mbedug[/url]

We’ll have more updates for you this week to give you a glimpse at other areas, monsters and characters for Legrand Legacy. Be sure to let us know in the comments below what you think of today’s update!

notes.content:

notes.title: Team’s Hidden Talents - Part 2
notes.content:
Welcome to a new Legrand Legacy Kickstarter update! 

Before we get to today's content, we wanted to talk with you about something very important: The Fallen Gladiators of Legrand initiative! By becoming one of the Fallen Gladiators of Legrand, you'll get your name added to a plaque outside of the Arena where Finn fights for his life! On top of this you'll also receive a Kickstarter exclusive Fallen Gladiators of Legrand avatar!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/375/191/a5a459ae9f965f36fc1dab7c949c37ef_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1486062940&auto=format&lossless=true&s=35fc7d60930e6fa70871b16261699ef9[/img]

How do you become part of the Fallen Gladiators of Legrand? It's very easy! All you need to do is raise your current pledge by £5 without changing your reward tier, and you're all set! Managing your pledge is very easy, as you can see below:

[h1]Step 1 - Click on the green "Manage your pledge" button at the top right of the page.[/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/369/231/b28b70a6b312cf8993773a6eb10c4fa9_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1486014318&auto=format&q=92&s=a945b919c1add7d3fd187a716ac9611f[/img]

[h1]Step 2 - Click on the blue "Change your pledge" button on the next page.[/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/369/236/ebe3daa82c29616aa6f2c8fd7f56540e_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1486014335&auto=format&q=92&s=ed4c5f17728fdfa0f71878dbd24030d8[/img]

[h1]Step 3 -  Increase your current pledge by £5 and do not change your reward tier.[/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/369/238/23e0fed1fb051bf260481b58faa8d387_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1486014352&auto=format&q=92&s=8f7c10db57cfa13cc11153276de0b253[/img]

[h1]Step 4 - Click on the green Continue button you can see in the image above (next to where you just increased your pledge).[/h1]

And that's it! After raising your pledge by £5, be sure to change your Kickstarter name to add "Fallen Gladiator of Legrand" to show your support!

Uwil Winata (Executive Producer/Lead Game Designer) and AJ Jonathan (Producer/Director/Audio Director) are big fans of the Final Fantasy series, and there is one game in particular they're very fond of: Final Fantasy VIII. Nobuo Uematsu is a music legend, and his work in this entry is something that instantly grabbed their attention. 

One song in particular, which we're sure you're familiar with, definitely stands out from the rest: Eyes on Me. For today, we give you APERPLEA and their rendition of this classic. APERPLEA is AJ Jonathan (keys, beatbox, and vox) and Puspallia Panggabean (vocals), who together have performed in various jazz festivals around Indonesia.

https://youtu.be/6ngfLOLY6Fc

We hope you have enjoyed this music video that we recorder especially for you. If you love Final Fantasy VIII, or if you feel... differently about the title, be sure to let us know in the comments below! Come share with us your memories from playing this JRPG:

notes.title: Dorei – Fishermen Village
notes.content:
Welcome to a new Kicktarter update! Before we get right to it, we wanted to say thank you to everyone who has been sharing the link the Legrand Legacy campaign, not to mention those of you who have raised your pledges! We're now at over 80% funded with more than 750 backers, and that means you've reached a bonus goal!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/356/796/122ab32c199eb1685fff9d159069e962_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485930086&auto=format&lossless=true&s=fed550d2718bd7518927e40b32f830ac[/img]

[b]Next stop is 1,000 backers in total for Legrand Legacy![/b]

Dorei is an idyllic and serene fishermen's village located in Western Legrand. The area isn’t visited by a lot of traders or foreigners mainly because of its distance from the higher populated areas of Legrand. 

Locals must, therefore, fulfill their daily needs by fishing and hunting. In fact, it almost seems as if the effects of the Mugna Feud - the ongoing war between the Kingdoms of Fandor and Altea - have yet to reach the shores of this peaceful village!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/356/916/95b785b8763cc562a353c0d626adfdfc_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485931110&auto=format&lossless=true&s=2ee12b2a1a9fecaf1a2d9e833afcb096[/img]

[b]The People of Dorei[/b]

The people of Dorei are mainly the Muiri tribe, a nautical clan of traditional seafarers who still hold true to their original roots and worships Lir as the One and Only Almighty. They are some of the kindest and most gentle souls in all of Legrand, which is why they have a very good relationship with the famously reclusive and cautious Ao Si.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/356/934/1cef29a4c6c71b1fd0f1fe671b959f87_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1485931206&auto=format&q=92&s=5757dfc74214ce33f7d16bf42c94b536[/img]

[b]The Houses[/b]

The locals live humbly in airy traditional houses made of light wood with dried grass on their walls. The sun can be blazing hot at times but the hay roof keeps the houses cool and comfortable. The Muiris are also skilled in painting beautifully patterned carpets – you can see some of their handiwork in the picture below.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/356/937/78a61f0e901b7b97950e1c20b3d82bff_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1485931240&auto=format&q=92&s=d3520390eda5925ae8d0ba6c8ea547f1[/img]

We can’t wait to show you the kind of (mis)adventures Finn and his friends will encounter in Dorei! 

What do you think of this location? Let us know in the comments below!

Dorei is an idyllic and serene fishermen's village located in Western Legrand. The area isn’t visited by a lot of traders or foreigners mainly because of its distance from the higher populated areas of Legrand. 

Locals must, therefore, fulfill their daily needs by fishing and hunting. In fact, it almost seems as if the effects of the Mugna Feud - the ongoing war between the Kingdoms of Fandor and Altea - have yet to reach the shores of this peaceful village!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/356/916/95b785b8763cc562a353c0d626adfdfc_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485931110&auto=format&lossless=true&s=2ee12b2a1a9fecaf1a2d9e833afcb096[/img]

[b]The People of Dorei[/b]

The people of Dorei are mainly the Muiri tribe, a nautical clan of traditional seafarers who still hold true to their original roots and worships Lir as the One and Only Almighty. They are some of the kindest and most gentle souls in all of Legrand, which is why they have a very good relationship with the famously reclusive and cautious Ao Si.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/356/934/1cef29a4c6c71b1fd0f1fe671b959f87_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1485931206&auto=format&q=92&s=5757dfc74214ce33f7d16bf42c94b536[/img]

[b]The Houses[/b]

The locals live humbly in airy traditional houses made of light wood with dried grass on their walls. The sun can be blazing hot at times but the hay roof keeps the houses cool and comfortable. The Muiris are also skilled in painting beautifully patterned carpets – you can see some of their handiwork in the picture below.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/356/937/78a61f0e901b7b97950e1c20b3d82bff_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1485931240&auto=format&q=92&s=d3520390eda5925ae8d0ba6c8ea547f1[/img]

We can’t wait to show you the kind of (mis)adventures Finn and his friends will encounter in Dorei! 

What do you think of this location? Let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Lucia – The Cynical Beauty
notes.content:
Hello everyone! For today's update we've decided to bring the spotlight over a new character: the striking royal, Lucia. 

Lucia is beautiful, brainy, and charming. She exudes old world glamour and oozes elegance, making good on what one would expect from a member of the royal family. As the dutiful High Chancellor, she’s also very proud and extremely protective of the heritage of her people, the Ao Si race. Sadly, it is this very passion that leads her to become firmly skeptical of the future of Legrand. Because of this, Lucia has chosen not to take sides in the ongoing war between the Kingdoms of Fandor and Altea.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/332/860/e0e345684a3ba3c824e8bd6fae321b3f_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1485763024&q=92&s=f2942b5c080b432efa9e15a636f2cd13[/img]

She also has powerful magic affinity and it is rumored that she has cast a magical mist to shield the township of the Ao Si so that outsiders cannot easily discover it. Lucia prefers to stay within the confine of her hometown, which is why she and the rest of the Ao Si rarely make an appearance to the outside world.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/332/894/13d2b2d34e75e6651f268d903da4fb7a_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485763345&auto=format&lossless=true&s=89e925865642d7e4fe9a2489ef2f2316[/img]

[url= Lucia 3D Model]https://skfb.ly/YqUY[/url]

What do you think of Lucia? Do let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Ostia – Most Corrupt City in Legrand
notes.content:
What a week! Legrand Legacy has been off to a great start, and thanks to your support the Kicktarter is now at over £30,000 with over 700 backers! Next milestone is hitting 750 backers so that you can unlock a bonus goal for the campaign. 

Ostia is the main entry port to Southern Legrand. Despite its popularity, the city is unfortunately plagued with the highest crime rates and corruption in all of Legrand - especially since the Mugna Feud began. Residents of the two warring Kingdoms of Fandor and Altea come to Ostia to escape the war. They arrive in search of a better life, but many have to resort to criminal activities as the war makes it so fewer and fewer legit work opportunities ever become available.

Local citizens and visitors alike love to hang out in the infamous Fair Maiden Inn where people can have a great pint of Ostian beer and a delightful meal of grilled sea food - or they can stay for a night or two if they so desire to take in the sights and the atmosphere.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/303/605/956b7fbb283b8e5b51b6b0ca30bd60c3_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1485498557&auto=format&q=92&s=41350e141b1b13aa6ee189508afa4c14[/img]

[b]Gate of Glory[/b]

The Gate of Glory was erected in memory of fallen heroes and was once the pride and joy of Ostian citizens. However, corruption and violence have devastated this once glorious entrance reducing it to nothing but a pile of rubbles and a sad memory of days gone by.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/303/628/f7e99e5fe6e360be5518a742352ded7b_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1485498926&auto=format&q=92&s=e770f8bc144270b921fb7f0764e4b26e[/img]

[b]Maerckall Tribune Arena[/b]

The Maerckall Tribune is one of the bloodiest yet most popular arenas where slaves fight each other to the death, mainly for the entertainment of Ostian citizens. A mysterious yet unexpectedly powerful fighter currently reigns supreme, successfully defeating all adversaries thrown his way. Hmm… who could this fighter be?

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/303/632/ebaa1be7124c9f051f14c47ff8d702ef_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1485498979&auto=format&q=92&s=4fc11a8797cd244e16be4783a2dbcc0d[/img]

[b]Ostia Catacombs[/b]

The Ostia Catacombs make up the derelict and desolate graveyard for Ostia's citizens. Knowing Finn and friends, they’ll probably run into a lot of trouble here! What will they find during their time with the departed?

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/303/639/2d7b68dd2a02563a2cfcff2efbde2654_original.PNG?w=639&fit=max&v=1485499004&auto=format&lossless=true&s=bb7706fd5a01ba761c0beabd84e83b6e[/img]

Can you imagine the kind of monsters and people who live in this city? What do you think about Ostia? Let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Version A vs. Version B
notes.content:
By now you’ve probably played the new version B of our Pre-Alpha. You may be wondering, what’s the difference behind this new version and the previous one (version A)?

[b]VERSION A[/b] is the original Pre-Alpha that we launched with our first Kickstarter. If you watch YouTube Let’s Play videos dated before January 18th, 2017, they are most likely playing this build. Version A is available only on GameJolt.

[b]VERSION B[/b] is the revised Pre-Alpha that we launched with this new Kickstarter. We took your feedback from last time and have implemented some changes into this new build. Version B is available on Steam as well as on GameJolt.

Now let’s talk about some of the things that have changed in Version B.

[h1]Battle UI[/h1]

A big change for version B is that we now have an additional user interface which gives you detailed information about the enemy. This includes, for example, monster type, element type, weakness, and HP bar. Our goal is to make it easier for you to plan your attack and defense actions.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/452/e0d1683ca42bb8b67a45750f21a43e2d_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485320742&auto=format&lossless=true&s=b093b9ac355290c4118c0a98e6a66813[/img]

[h1]Action Circle Tempo (ACT)[/h1]

You will notice that ACT now only appears at the beginning of combat. Also, based on popular request, you can now choose your own flavor for ACT depending on the desired playing experience:  

•	You can choose either to press a fixed button (easier) or to get randomized buttons (harder)

•	You can choose either to have a fixed (easier) or randomized (harder) Perfect/Good area

•	The arrows in version A have been replaced with ABXY, which we hope will make it more intuitive

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/488/70cd8b2dcd7181868e94c2e465e31ad0_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485321045&auto=format&lossless=true&s=be869230df6d346155b93e41d50cf23e[/img]

[h1]Character’s Skill Attribute[/h1]

At the end of the battle, you can now immediately add Attribute Points (ATP) to level up your character.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/504/6632f447b9292b94310c54369a691978_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485321178&auto=format&lossless=true&s=97892e3bc67cd65b345e8a675106485b[/img]

[h1]Other Cosmetic Changes[/h1]

You may also notice several cosmetic changes which we hope will make your experience more enjoyable. These include enhanced visual effects, improved textures for some monsters, map pointers, and more!

[h1]Why do we have two versions of the Pre-Alpha?[/h1]

We want Legrand Legacy to be a game that YOU enjoy, so we will be conducting a poll after the Kickstarter is over to gather your feedback about both versions so that we can know into which direction to take the Legrand Legacy gameplay.

[url=https://ksr-video.imgix.net/assets/015/279/540/bdc6c2ed73396eba15ed61b7a4aabad3_h264_high.mp4]check the video here![/url]

But for now, we do want to hear from you! Do you prefer the ACT dial to appear right before each attack and defense action (as is the case for version A) or all at once at the beginning of combat (as it happens now in version B)? Please let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: The Humble Owls
notes.content:
One of the things we love to work on for Legrand Legacy is the monsters as they leave a lot of room for creativity – this allows us to let our imaginations run wild! For inspiration, we often look at everything from nature to mythical creatures to find the right balance for our creatures so that they fit within the Legrand Legacy universe.

For today we want to give you a look at two monsters that were based on a noble creature: the owl! Owls are a classic staple in fantasy lore, and are perfect for the world of Legrand Legacy

[b]Kalkkhukka - Loyal Warriors[/b]

The Kalkkhukka are vicious warriors who possess high intelligence and work as the extremely loyal guardians of Dring's Keep. To attack their enemies, they rely on their heavy serrated blade which can paralyze their enemies in a matter of seconds. Their physical appearance is a combination of thick fur all over their head, back, chest as well as some scaly skin on their legs.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/262/399/0dfe406eb42705d663190afc27c44235_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485204549&auto=format&lossless=true&s=b18510d79767b6e38b531ca3c6283c52[/img]

[url=https://skfb.ly/VSHB]Here's the 3D model for Kalkkhukka[/url]

[b]Bwoorhan - Nocturnal Jungle Terrors[/b]

The Bwoorhan are ferocious and territorial jungle creatures with owl-like features, sharp green scales, and deadly claws. They usually come alive at night to hunt, but are difficult to spot due to their tree-like antlers which allow them to blend seamlessly with their surroundings. 

Some people have tried to tame them but most ended up losing a finger or two in the process. If you hear a Bwoorhan’s distinctive shrilling calls you better run because this creature packs a powerful punch!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/262/501/b5e13cee8c9d3a9e82f2a4b6d6b4dd54_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485204963&auto=format&lossless=true&s=3bd457ade4e6e44a92f5779e35b0795f[/img]

[url=https://skfb.ly/YqVZ]Here’s the 3D model for Bwoorhan[/url]

What do you think of the Kalkkhukka and Bwoorhan? Please let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Royal Bureaucrat Roland
notes.content:
Welcome to a new Kickstarter update! Before we dive into today's update, we wanted to thank you for helping us to reach over 500 backers for the first 48 hours of the campaign! This is a great milestone to reach in only two days, and it also unlocks a new bonus goal for the game:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/235/211/18b90aeb97ce4bd1431586865cc4458f_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1484941439&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5af6b16c66b258e2913c3ebd217a85f9[/img]

If you joined us from the beginning, then you probably have met most of Legrand Legacy's characters. Here's a summary of all the characters we have introduced so far:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/234/619/83ead88e1f088fee92bb204fefe4f22f_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1484937474&auto=format&lossless=true&s=ecf60dec48aa8d4ea3e83c47852ca26f[/img]

In this update, we want to present you to another fine member of the Legrand Legacy ensemble: Roland!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/234/644/aecb2852640c7d24c82c0a0dedbad00a_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1484937612&q=92&s=a13005703e232020624fe28ba5b3f8e5[/img]

Roland may not be as burly as his brother Gunther, but he definitely has more brains to make up for it. Since young, Roland has preferred reading rather than sword fighting or horse riding. As a result, he has developed a keen sharp mind, capable enough for running domestic affairs within the kingdom and worthy of leading an army from the war council table. However, Roland often lets his intelligence get in the way. He looks down on those who are not as smart as him and generally treats people like a dispensable commodity.

notes.title: Royal Bureaucrat Roland
notes.content:
Welcome to a new Kickstarter update! Before we dive into today's update, we wanted to thank you for helping us to reach over 500 backers for the first 48 hours of the campaign! This is a great milestone to reach in only two days, and it also unlocks a new bonus goal for the game:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/235/211/18b90aeb97ce4bd1431586865cc4458f_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1484941439&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5af6b16c66b258e2913c3ebd217a85f9[/img]

If you joined us from the beginning, then you probably have met most of Legrand Legacy's characters. Here's a summary of all the characters we have introduced so far:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/234/619/83ead88e1f088fee92bb204fefe4f22f_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1484937474&auto=format&lossless=true&s=ecf60dec48aa8d4ea3e83c47852ca26f[/img]

In this update, we want to present you to another fine member of the Legrand Legacy ensemble: Roland!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/234/644/aecb2852640c7d24c82c0a0dedbad00a_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1484937612&q=92&s=a13005703e232020624fe28ba5b3f8e5[/img]

Roland may not be as burly as his brother Gunther, but he definitely has more brains to make up for it. Since young, Roland has preferred reading rather than sword fighting or horse riding. As a result, he has developed a keen sharp mind, capable enough for running domestic affairs within the kingdom and worthy of leading an army from the war council table. However, Roland often lets his intelligence get in the way. He looks down on those who are not as smart as him and generally treats people like a dispensable commodity.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/234/934/dca1a6d342db013825740fd3b40e47cc_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1484939616&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a13a04ebab22f8a2d98987d499df31be[/img]

notes.title: Welcome to Legrand Legacy!
notes.content:
Old friends, new friends, welcome to the new and revamped Legrand Legacy Kickstarter! We're excited to share this journey with all of you, and we want to say thanks to everyone who has supported us from the very beginning, as well as to everyone who has just learned about our game!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/224/944/69fd0eeba66e7b0d050aa1991f442195_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1484856386&auto=format&q=92&s=7d32d2b301e04840a24d2347be517eac[/img]

Also, we took note of your feedback and have updated and rebalanced our Pre-Alpha Prologue, so please let us know what you think of this new version (Version B) once you get to try it! We hope that you will have a good time exploring Rahas Desert and Tel Harran, the City of Slavers.

We’ve been asked about how we managed to launch a new campaign for Legrand Legacy at a lower main goal, so we thought we’d talk about it with you! We mentioned this in a project update for our previous campaign, so here’s a direct quote from that:

During the holidays we were approached by a group who sees the potential in Legrand Legacy, and we have secured a deal with them to cover part of the development costs for Legrand Legacy as long as we can secure the rest with a new Kickstarter campaign! This will allows us to lower the funding goal for Legrand Legacy to £40,000 for this second go.

And this is why we did a new Kickstarter for Legrand Legacy for £40,000!

SOCIAL MEDIA BONUS GOALS

What are Social Media Bonus Goals, you ask? These are extra bonus goals you can help us reach to improve Legrand Legacy and make it even better. You can help by following us on Twitter, by visiting and liking our Facebook, or simply by becoming a Kickstarter backer! So please spread the word about Legrand Legacy and help us achieve more goals and make the game better for everyone.

You can see the goals we have reached, as well as the ones you’re currently helping us reach by checking images in the “Social Media Bonus Goals” section in the main campaign page, which we are also sharing with you below.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/224/983/636f22ad261a0c51d8458e43ee8884c3_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1484856577&auto=format&lossless=true&s=1dcc208026f0df80889d5887f4fca8ee[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/224/977/c2f2a67a1386a63bb3c33c4dcb2b6276_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1484856557&auto=format&lossless=true&s=ef7228acf1565234c9abf5610d91ee3a[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/224/965/1c83055d36a35b4ede075ef03943c5e2_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1484856481&auto=format&lossless=true&s=73db512cc480399a3243930478958ac1[/img]

Why? Because during the last campaign we managed to hit several Social Media Bonus Goals for the Twitter and Facebook categories, not to mention that thanks to your early support we’ve already reached one of the goals for the total number of backers for Legrand Legacy!

Once again, thank you so much for your support! We look forward to reading your comments, so please let us know what you think.

[url=https://twitter.com/LegrandLegacy][img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/224/992/8852b3fc0a96c1eb74042394919759c8_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1484856638&auto=format&lossless=true&s=c4cc6300758c28cbf500a9253b10231b[/img][/url]

notes.content:

notes.title: Legrand Legacy Is Coming Back To Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Welcome back, friends of Legrand Legacy! We hope everyone had a good time during the holidays, and that you’re crushing those New Year resolutions!

As for us, we gave in to the holidays in full. We went back to see our families, so that our kids and significant others wouldn’t forget us. We went out to restaurants, enjoyed presents and a lot of karaoke with the relatives… but our thoughts were always with Legrand Legacy and how all of you care about the project.

During the holidays we were approached by a group who sees the potential in Legrand Legacy, and we have secured a deal with them to cover part of the development costs for Legrand Legacy as long as we can secure the rest with a new Kickstarter campaign! This will allows us to lower the funding goal for Legrand Legacy to £40,000 for this second go.

As such, we're thrilled to announce that Legrand Legacy’s NEW Kickstarter campaign will launch on Wednesday, January 18th!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/137/333/0426d1f7dd602475b06ee81edd13c1a4_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1484169502&auto=format&q=92&s=7b4e368e7f9c5208a1e35e4772a8b39b[/img]

We invite all of you to visit our page on the first day to take advantage of the Early Bird tiers… and so that you can play the updated Pre-Alpha! We took note of your feedback for our Pre-Alpha and have updated and rebalanced it, so be sure to let us know what you think once you get to try it next week!

Please note that your pledge for the last campaign was not collected since we didn’t make it to our goal, and your pledge is not transferred to the new Kickstarter. We therefore really need your support once the campaign for Legrand Legacy is live so that you can help to take us to the main goal and beyond!

Mark your calendars… and we hope to see all of you back next week!

notes.title: Don’t Cry Because It’s Over, Smile Because It Happened - Dr Seuss
notes.content:
Friends of Legrand Legacy, this is it. Together, we have finally crossed the finish line in the most spectacular fashion!

Thank you for joining us in our final countdown live stream and on our incredible journey! All of you have believed in us from the very beginning until the end and we are humbled by your support and encouragement.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/910/846/cbb0f1eec672a4251b84e7724b2226fd_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1481920719&auto=format&q=92&s=2f45b0fbbf86fe1e74a52f66b60e95e5[/img]

The final 48 hours have been nothing short of exhilarating. We saw an incredible surge in new backers join the cause, and many raised pledges to help the campaign. Friendly strangers rallied for Legrand Legacy on social media and it's because of all of this that there’s over 750 people from all corners of the world who believe in our vision.

Now you’re probably thinking, what's next?

After a month long Kickstarter campaign, we are going to take a little break and spend some well-deserved quality time with our friends and loved ones. Rest assured that we are not giving up on Legrand Legacy. We will come back from the holiday feeling refreshed, recharged, and ready to restrategize!

In the meantime, we hope that you will stay in touch! Please sign up for our newsletter, follow us on Twitter, and do like our Facebook page. This is not the last you'll hear from us!

notes.title: Borttung - The Grim Experiment
notes.content:
Hi all! How many times have you played the Pre-Alpha Prologue for Legrand Legacy? Do you remember Dringr's Keep? During your time there you came across a very particular monster we’re sure you haven’t forgotten about!

The Borttung is a species of boars that was hunted down to extinction. One day a human decided it would be fun to experiment on a rotten boar carcass, hoping that his work would allow him to taste its delicious meat once again. Unfortunately, his experiment failed miserably and thus emerged the first and new Borttung - a gruesome undead pig with flailing innards... and an insatiable appetite for human brains.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/899/632/29775dd81626713262a6edf69fd33fbe_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1481836651&auto=format&lossless=true&s=f3efaddedf4619869f47c6fdf36085fc[/img]

We also wanted to mention that tomorrow we'll be doing a live stream during the final three hours of the Kickstarter campaign, so we hope you can all join us!

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/semisoftstudio][img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/899/641/7a8bf70c022c70b5e5013ccd2f237a82_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1481836717&auto=format&lossless=true&s=954bc6df9d4cb82dcb78842e9fc86b22[/img][/url]

notes.title: Final 48 Hours!
notes.content:
As you read this, we have exactly 48 hours to go on our Kickstarter campaign!

For us, the journey has been nothing short of a rollercoaster ride. We cheered when the number of backers went up, smiled when people upgraded their reward tiers, and frowned a little when thing slowed down a bit. We obsessed over every single word we used on the main page, pondered about which GIFs would best represent Legrand Legacy at its current state, and spent months thinking about a variety of meaningful rewards and updates that we can offer to our backers. We sincerely hope that you have enjoyed reading all the updates that have given you a sneak peek into the fantasy world of Legrand Legacy!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/885/166/4a1b96792c0edd100688b70ab3da76c6_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1481742426&auto=format&q=92&s=722978c8ef18552353e5568673c97ac5[/img]

We also spurred quite a heated discussion on PC Gamer. Then Alpha Beta Gamer called us “very impressive” and “shows great promise,” while Cliqist said the game is “polished” and “plays well.” And then, somehow, our cinematic trailer also landed on Gamespot!

Above all, we have so far made a lot of new friends. We saw first time backers coming onto Kickstarter JUST to pledge for Legrand Legacy. Some people sent us very enthusiastic emails, Tweets, and Facebook messages because they simply cannot wait to be a part of the game. We watched as our game was played by some very entertaining YouTubers and Twitchers, all eager to beat epic boss Klahmaran, wanting to see more from Legrand Legacy.

All of that has been possible because of YOU!

Every. Single. One. Of. You.

So, as we approach the finish line, we present to you a little video that captures our journey together - from the very beginning to where we stand now.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j1yx84l5rNA

Last but not least, we want to thank our friends at PR Hound who have helped us every step of the way - from helping to design our campaign page to ramping up our social media presence, to promoting, to garnering significant press coverage for Legrand Legacy, and then some! They do work beyond the realms of PR and have been an integral part of our crowdfunding process by also helping with our updates, always making sure the world knows about Legrand Legacy.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/884/904/5516199fe81d533fce1a906a20283f77_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1481741007&auto=format&q=92&s=4e78723c46351e295bea487ad28a4418[/img]

In the meantime, please continue sharing Legrand Legacy in social media, at forums, or even through your blogs and channels! And if you haven’t done so, like us on Facebook and follow us on Twitter by clicking the images below!

[url=https://www.facebook.com/legrandlegacy/][img]https://gallery.mailchimp.com/610106e55433ae621b485979a/images/e9403e86-7ff0-447d-bd4e-feed95e2080e.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/legrandlegacy][img]https://gallery.mailchimp.com/610106e55433ae621b485979a/images/897091d7-0fee-466a-8764-03414eda3c57.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Mini-Games
notes.content:
In previous updates, we have revealed a few exclusive features for Legrand Legacy, such as Tactical War and the Headquarters system. However, those of you who have been playing JRPG for a while have probably experienced a mini-game or two during your adventure. All the best RPG we have played have a mini-game or two, and Legrand Legacy is not the exception. After all, Finn and the gang might need some distractions to keep them entertained during their quest!

There are a few fun mini-games that we are currently working on as we plan Legrand Legacy, including things such as fencing, archery, and fishing, to name a few. During your time with these mini-games, you’ll earn points and said points can be later exchanged for legendary items or achievements. You can also revisit these games and try to beat your own high scores! Please note that the mini games are still work-in-progress, so we’ll be showing you one of them today!

Here’s a sneak peek of how the fencing mini-game will probably look in the game.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/873/928/47a6e60f1c98d2ecce7c07240e223e60_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1481662819&q=92&s=1de4f994601fe387c0f5e6e8ecf068c4[/img]

What are some of your favorite mini-games from the JRPG you’ve played? What do you think of the mini-game we’ve shown you for Legrand Legacy? Let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Headquarters System
notes.content:
Welcome to a new Kickstarter update! We want to start today's post by thanking everyone who has shared the campaign on social media. You've also been following us on Twitter and liking us on Facebook, and because of this you've managed to reach not one but two new Social Media Bonus goal! Thanks to this, once Legrand Legacy is funded, we’ll be adding a new weapon upgrade recipe to the game and a fourth bonus song to the digital soundtrack! 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/852/902/9b3de04bd14f05f1174011313acb1f1a_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1481521294&auto=format&lossless=true&s=2360ed04cc352dfac5bb77c3a1d0b3a3[/img]

On top of this we've reached a very important milestone: Legrand Legacy is now 70% funded! There’s still four more days to go, so please continue to share the link to the Kickstarter with everyone you know so that we can make it to the main goal and beyond!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/860/866/2121d82aa3df36c41a0a842923ce74f2_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1481576338&auto=format&q=92&s=71bffe6d78b6747d4e3f8bfb77614c73[/img]

In the Pre-Alpha Prologue, you get a sneak preview of a lot of the fun things you can do in Legrand Legacy. You’ve explored towns, dangerous dungeons and enjoyed a sidequest or two. But there’s more to the game than what we’ve shown you so far, which is why we’re on Kickstarter to secure the funds needed to implement all the extra content into the game. One of the cool features we plan to add to Legrand Legacy to make it even better is the headquarters system! As always, please remember that the headquarters systems is currently work-in-progress, so the designs and screenshots below are not final.  

As your troops grow bigger, you might wonder “where do I keep all of them stationed?” The answer is simple: at your very own Dumville Castle! This is your base of operation and headquarters, and while there you’ll be able to talk to your allies and get to know them better. Behold, the majestic Dumville Castle!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/853/673/f78e37acfa5c39c63d4614628533754c_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1481528052&auto=format&q=92&s=8e48e3fb85c2177dc352d592c4230b34[/img]

BUT WAIT!

There’s something very important that you should know. Dumville Castle is currently in ruins. War has ravaged most of the land, and your task is to rebuild this once majestic castle back to its former glory and then some!

During your journey, you will encounter a lot of potential allies that you can recruit for your cause. There are many things to fix in the castle, so you will need a group of very talented individuals, such as blacksmiths, builders, and shopkeepers, among others, to make it happen.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/853/723/ad21f275a7ba970f075dbe0a0a032a3f_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1481528494&q=92&s=734e4f1b25685019ba02e136630cdf84[/img]

If you ask nicely enough, some of these allies will even set up shop in your headquarters and help you rebuild the castle. So explore away and don’t be shy to talk to everyone you meet! You’ll never know where these potential allies may be hiding.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/853/802/5fa53244420fe3a4f6b5738ee9c80cf2_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1481529387&q=92&s=3e85988f427189a8850e0319d314f02b[/img]

As part of the Social Media Bonus Goals that you have unlocked, we will be adding new recruitable NPC to help you rebuild Dumville Castle!  

What do you think about the headquarters system? Are you looking forward to rebuilding your castle? Please let us know in the comment below!

notes.title: Visual Effects
notes.content:
While we’ve been hard at work on the content for the Kickstarter campaign and the many updates we've been doing, we’ve also been working on the game itself to create a better experience for players. We have received a lot of feedback from those of you who have played the Pre-Alpha Prologue, and we plan to incorporate said feedback into the next revision of the game.

Once funded, one of the areas we’ll be working to improve is the game’s visual effects, which makes it the perfect topic for today’s update! Please note that what we’ll be showing here is still a work-in-progress, so the designs and effects are not final.

Let’s begin with Finn’s Slash. We want to create the impression of a swift yet weighty sword slash that splatters upon impact, so here’s an early draft for Finn’s Slash.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/843/307/5f74b4b44138053bdff7152b8254799d_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1481439287&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9177c67da2f6c7c5e2e59ae7266b5e41[/img]

Next is Arc Slash, Finn’s Arcana. An Arcana is powerful, so it’s supposed to look dramatic and memorable, literally shaking the ground. So we, therefore, came up with the following design, which combines swift sword slashes with an explosion of dusty particles that rise from the ground.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/843/306/679b153ab98a148cf6bf77a3a635baf5_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1481439268&auto=format&lossless=true&s=053f5589c2f4b31b03699532923f474b[/img]

And here’s Klahmaran, everyone’s favorite big bad guy. He’s flaming hot, so we came up with a design that truly takes the temperature up a notch by combining symbolic illustrations with a wall of blazing fire flares that devours the entire room!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/843/338/8a86afabdfab1a2b7a671401d7e3bbcc_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1481439746&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a57dcb4bd84249536952944139e9dd3f[/img]

What do you think about these visual effects? Do you think that once implemented they will make a big difference in your gaming experience? Please let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Explore Legrand
notes.content:
In our previous updates, we have shown you several of the locations in Legrand Legacy. You’ve visited Tel Harran, the City of Slavers, the treacherous and deadly Rahas Desert, Shapur, the city for the exiled, as well as the bustling coastal city of Dunabad.

However, there are still many regions to explore, each with its own unique monsters and inhabitants – areas we are currently working on! For today’s update, we will give you an exclusive sneak preview of some of the areas that with your support might get a chance to be included in the final game!

First up is Dorei Dock, an idyllic fisherman village and home to some of the kindest and gentlest souls in all of Legrand.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/835/112/95b785b8763cc562a353c0d626adfdfc_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1481354384&auto=format&lossless=true&s=65809f7989d4b6f451b9aa039d4047d1[/img]

Next, we have Ostia, the main entry port to Southern Legrand –the city is unfortunately plagued with high crime rates and corruption.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/835/116/d742a278f109f9ebf1c9ec5895fd5284_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1481354415&auto=format&q=92&s=fe6f06c2c6f27c057426fe300c08af87[/img]

The Gate of Glory is the pride and joy of Ostian citizens. We have created an original musical score in its namesake to capture our heroes' valiant and adventurous spirits!

If you have played the Pre-Alpha Prologue, you’ll know that Geddo is a Norn. The Norns used to live in a swampy forest in Southern Legrand called Finias. However, the Great War hundreds of years ago turned Finias into a city of ruins packed with the spirits of the undead...

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/835/120/87417ba18c330ce93ff7c2d770327377_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1481354449&auto=format&lossless=true&s=128783627e5e4b84c089233b386c63c8[/img]

Finally, we have the beautiful Gwenelle Forest, which is the only proper green area left in Legrand. Rumor has it that this lush forest is protected by the magic of some mysterious celestial creatures, so if you get here, you’ll need to be careful.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/835/123/f149b7341ff54564b897f7ece50115ee_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1481354478&auto=format&q=92&s=986a64a777824db0ac66915db52e9d6e[/img]

Which regions did you like best? Can you think of the type of monsters and local inhabitants you might find in each? Let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Tactical War
notes.content:
Welcome to the final week for Legrand Legacy! Before we dive into today's update, we wanted to mention that we have a new Thunderclap campaign going on right now... and we need your support! You can sign in with any of your social media accounts and with a couple of clicks add your support to the cause. When we hit the final 48 hours, a shout will go out on social media about Legrand Legacy hitting its final 2 days of crowdfunding.

[url=https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/50776-final-48-hours-in-kickstarter][img]http://i.imgur.com/cEstnjv.png[/img][/url]

There is a lot for you to do as you Legrand Legacy, from exploring its towns, markets, and underground dungeons, to slaying gruesome monsters and gathering or crafting items. You have experienced this in our Pre-Alpha Prologue. However, there are a few cool things we plan to add to Legrand Legacy once funded to make the game even more enjoyable and challenging – and one of them is Tactical war!

We thought you, our backers, would appreciate getting a first look at this feature. Please note that this s is currently a work-in-progress element, so the designs and screenshots below are certainly not final.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/823/440/554f96467affa39675bc17882f44a158_original.PNG?w=639&fit=max&v=1481260799&auto=format&lossless=true&s=c781f36735d6157d191f2e798c8bdb7a[/img]

You’ll have generals to select and use during Tactical War. As you can see from the image below, every general has his/her own strengths and weaknesses, which you must always keep in mind when planning your strategy.

Before you decided what to do next, you can check the available information in order for you to evaluate your odds.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/823/445/e05b1d3deb9ddee416f429c40799c56c_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1481260867&auto=format&lossless=true&s=24c64778d10a5e73a97ad2a237d7f7e8[/img]

Once you’re ready, you take your turn and make your move.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/823/571/2b97012788a1b6e99e1596c76d7a1b70_original.PNG?w=639&fit=max&v=1481262224&auto=format&lossless=true&s=d8287c1336f3f4fe13410c64b5589fbf[/img]

If you’re good to go, you can select to attack one of the available targets within your range for a battle to commence.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/823/574/2801dcc6176f92b36588d1727a11bba0_original.PNG?w=639&fit=max&v=1481262251&auto=format&lossless=true&s=ff450033feb69b25b89d03651308265c[/img]

Each general will also have a special arcana that can certainly be of great use during Tactical War. Just be careful to evaluate your options so that you can maximize its potential!

Once funded we will also add new War Generals to the game as part of the Social Media Bonus Goals that you’re helping us to achieve, so be sure to follow us on Twitter and like us on Facebook to do your part and help the cause!

What do you think about Legrand Legacy’s Tactical War feature? Let us know in the comments below!
